messages:
priya_sre: Heads up — we started seeing a sharp increase in auth-service 5xx and 401 errors at ~08:12 UTC. Customer-reported latency and token rejects are spiking.

sam_engineer: seeing the same. Spike in error rate from the signing/verify endpoint, latency up to 2.5s for some requests.

lina_devx: graphs show concurrent requests waiting on backend kv-cache lookups. Miss rate on kv-cache jumped from 4% to 65% around the same time.

priya_sre: impact: multiple customers reported request timeouts and 401s for API keys that were previously valid. Support queue growing.

marco_security: any recent rollout for key rotation or cache config? I pushed the signing-key rotation earlier today (08:00 UTC) and also a config tweak to kv-cache TTL (reduced from 300s -> 30s) to speed key invalidation for compliance.

sam_engineer: that TTL change would increase cache churn. If rotation causes a short window where many tokens need verification against newly loaded keys, we could overload the key backfill path.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollout finished for commit hash a1b2c3 at 08:03 UTC to auth-service.

priya_sre: logs excerpt: 
```
auth-service verify_token: key_lookup miss for kid=exp-2026-03-17-08:11:12
auth-service key_fetcher: db call latency 120ms, error rate 0.4%
auth-service verify_token: failed to fetch signing key -> 500 internal
```

lina_devx: repro steps (local emulate):
1) reduce kv-cache TTL to 30s
2) simulate signing key rotation (insert new kid, mark old as deprecated)
3) flood verify_token calls with mixed-old/new kid tokens
Expect: cache miss spikes and DB backfill pressure, some fetches time out -> 500s / fallbacks.

sam_engineer: quick mitigation options:
- revert TTL change to 300s (low friction)
- temporarily bypass cache for verification (force DB read but rate-limit)
- enable additional key-fetcher replicas to absorb backfill load

priya_sre: I rolled back the TTL change at 08:22 UTC. Pushing config rollback now.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: config-rollback commit d4e5f6 applied to auth-service at 08:24 UTC.

support_bot: Customer alert: decreased error reports after 08:30 UTC but still seeing residual 401s for a small subset.

marco_security: Why did the key backfill return 500s rather than falling back to old keys? Our verify logic should accept still-valid keys during rotation. Need to check error handling around missing kid + fetch failure.

sam_engineer: found stack trace: 
```
verify.go:line 172: if fetchKey(kid) == nil { return 500 }
fetch.go:line 98: DB client retries exhausted -> returns error not nil
```
So fetch failure path returns 500 rather than NACK / retry gracefully.

lina_devx: immediate patch: change fetch failure to treat as temporary and return 401 with Retry-After header instead of 500, while we stabilize backfill capacity. Also add exponential backoff and circuit-breaker around DB fetches.

priya_sre: applied a hotfix branch to change failure code path at 08:40 UTC and deployed to canary. Canary shows decreased 500s, 401s preferable for bad signature but service stays responsive.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: hotfix commit f7g8h9 to canary at 08:42 UTC.

sam_engineer: scaled key-fetcher workers from 2 -> 8 to handle the backfill surge at 08:45 UTC. Monitoring shows DB read latency normalized.

support_bot: support queue: number of active incidents fell by 70% after 08:50 UTC. A few customers still reporting stale tokens -> likely client-side caches.

marco_security: root cause hypothesis: concurrent deployment changed two variables (signing key rotation + aggressive kv-cache TTL) causing an amplification of key-backfill reads. The fetch failure path then caused 500s instead of softer failure semantics.

priya_sre: immediate next steps:
- complete rollback verification and ensure TTL rollback persisted across all clusters (owner: sam_engineer)
- merge hotfix to main, schedule full rollout with canary window and monitor 24h (owner: lina_devx)
- add metric & alert for kv-cache miss-rate > 10% during rotations (owner: priya_sre)
- update runbook to block simultaneous TTL/rotation changes (owner: marco_security)

sam_engineer: done verifying rollback at 09:05 UTC. All clusters running TTL=300s.

lina_devx: opened PR for hotfix -> main, will coordinate with SRE for staged rollout.

marco_security: also adding a safety gate: disallow TTL < 60s unless opt-in with runbook signoff.

priya_sre: postmortem owner assigned: lina_devx. Preliminary RCA to be drafted by EOD.

support_bot: closing customer-facing incident page: set to "monitoring". Will update customers once RCA is posted. :white_check_mark:

sam_engineer: logs and trace snippets pushed to incident runbook folder. If anyone needs specific traces, ping me.

priya_sre: thanks team — major win avoiding a prolonged outage. We'll follow up in the PM for the full postmortem and timeline. :bow:
